newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Hashimoto says will make Asian trip. [CORRECTED 02:46 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Japan's Hashimoto says will make Asian trip. [CORRECTED 02:46 GMT]

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto announced on Tuesday he would go ahead with a five-nation (corrects from 'four-nation') Asian tour next week despite the Lima hostage crisis.
The trip, starting on January seven, will take Hashimoto to Brunei, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Vietnam.
Earlier this week, at the height of the Lima hostage siege, foreign ministry officials had said Hashimoto was considering cancelling the trip.
"I am going ahead with the trip," Hashimoto told reporters. "I place my entire trust in Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori and have made arrangements so I can always be contacted."

A meeting between Marxist rebels and a Fujimori envoy led to the weekend release of 20 more hostages from the Japanese ambassador's Lima residence, leaving 83 captives in the mined and booby-trapped building the rebels seized on December 17.
